why: I checked every path and command the issue names against the 5 tracked files and the package.json scripts. Two references are wrong. First, the problem says "average() in src/stats.js returns NaN", but there is no src/stats.js. Only math.js exists, and the issue's own checks require './math.js'. The issue doesn't ask for src/stats.js to be created, so this misdescribes the repository. Second, an expect line and its proof require "`npm run lint` exits 0", but package.json only defines a "test" script. There's no lint script, so that command would fail, and the issue doesn't ask for one to be added. The other references do exist or come with the command: math.js, test/math.test.js, `npm test`/`node --test`, git show/checkout and node -e. The two broken references are enough to fail the criterion.
